content:
Here is the recipe JSON:
{
  "recipe_name": "Paneer Tikka",
  "ingredients": [
    "250 grams paneer",
    "1/2 cup plain yogurt",
    "1 tablespoon lemon juice",
    "1 teaspoon garam masala",
    "1 teaspoon cumin powder",
    "1/2 teaspoon coriander powder",
    "1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper",
    "1/2 teaspoon salt",
    "1/4 teaspoon black pepper",
    "2 tablespoons butter",
    "2 tablespoons vegetable oil",
    "2 onions, thinly sliced",
    "2 cloves garlic, minced",
    "1 teaspoon ginger paste",
    "Fresh cilantro, chopped"
  ],
  "steps": [
    {
      "step_number": 1,
      "instruction": "Cut the paneer into small cubes and set aside",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Make sure the paneer is fresh and of good quality"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 2,
      "instruction": "In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper",
      "time": "2 minutes",
      "tip": "Adjust the amount of spices according to your taste"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 3,
      "instruction": "Add the paneer cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Make sure the paneer is well coated with the marinade"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 4,
      "instruction": "Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes",
      "time": "30 minutes",
      "tip": "The longer you marinate, the better the flavor will be"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 5,
      "instruction": "Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "You can also use a skewer to grill the paneer"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 6,
      "instruction": "Thread the marinated paneer cubes onto skewers, if using",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Leave a little space between each piece of paneer"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 7,
      "instruction": "Brush the grill or grill pan with butter and oil",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "This will prevent the paneer from sticking"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 8,
      "instruction": "Grill the paneer for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it is golden brown and cooked through",
      "time": "10-14 minutes",
      "tip": "Flip the paneer gently to avoid breaking it"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 9,
      "instruction": "Serve the paneer tikka hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and accompanied by your favorite chutney or sauce",
      "time": "2 minutes",
      "tip": "You can also serve it with naan or basmati rice"
    }
  ]
}
